files.description: Product code changes (150 rows): product (name with model), stock_qty (whole number), old_code and new_code (four-digit whole numbers; the code is unchanged in 100 rows). No empty cells.

task_text: Index the table by old_code so that it can be used as a lookup of the new code. What is the total stock_qty of the product rows whose code did not change (new_code equal to old_code)? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Sum of stock_qty over the 100 rows with new_code == old_code.

predicted_direction.reason: Multiplying stock_qty by the index-vs-column comparison worked by position on 2.x; on 3.x the comparison is a Series labelled by old codes, the product aligns on labels and the sum collapses to 0.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row I05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
